summary: Tested Attribute Grouping feature end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed against live API (all 5 endpoints + validation + regression). Frontend: UI renders correctly with 4 tabs, real data (175 SKUs, ₹2.77 Cr revenue, 3 categories), sidebar link present, Compare flow produces BEST badge, regression routes (/transfers, /dashboard, /buy-planning) all load without error.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered on the level-selector dropdown. This comes from the dev instrumentation wrapping dynamic expressions inside <option> text. Cosmetic console-only warning; does not break functionality. Consider hiding instrumentation for <option> children or moving dynamic expression to a computed variable.

critical_code_review_comments: Good domain separation: pure functions in attribute_grouping.py with Repository + Service layers, easy to unit-test. 21 domain unit tests already exist and pass.
_tenant_match() correctly handles pre-multi-tenant seed data — matches convention used by buy_planning/_shared.py.
Pydantic Field(min_length=2) on List properly returns 422 for single-value compare request; same for empty forecast combination — validated.
Query(ge=1, le=365) on days validates range at FastAPI layer before hitting service; service-layer check is redundant but harmless.
Minor: the level-select <option> markup triggers a React dev-time hydration warning due to instrumentation injecting <span> children. Not a real bug but noisy in dev console.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 4 tabs render + interact; forecast final KPI cards not E2E-verified via UI because native <select> dropdowns need page.select_option, but underlying API verified via backend test)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing production tenant with 175 SKUs / 185k daily_sales rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attribute Grouping feature is working end-to-end. Backend endpoints: GET /api/analytics/attribute-grouping/{levels,sales/{key},trends/{key}}, POST .../{compare,forecast}. Production tenant returns levels: category, style, size, sku_type, sku_color, brand, gender, season, sub_category, etc. Forecast UI uses native <select> (not Radix combobox) so Playwright must use page.select_option('select', value). Backend forecast API verified working. Only flagged: cosmetic React dev hydration warning from instrumentation wrapping <option> children — safe to ignore.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Hydration warning is instrumentation artifact, not a real issue.
